threats.title: Missing Authentication on PaymentGateway
threats.description: The PaymentGateway external entity lacks authentication controls, enabling spoofing attacks.
threats.mitigation: Implement mutual TLS or token-based authentication on all payment gateway interactions.

threats.title: Sensitive Data Store Not Encrypted at Rest: OrderRepository
threats.description: The OrderRepository data store contains PII and order data without encryption at rest.
threats.mitigation: Enable AES-256 encryption at rest for the OrderRepository data store.

threats.title: Unencrypted Data Flow from CheckoutController
threats.description: Data flow from CheckoutController to OrderRepository is not encrypted in transit.
threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ on all internal service communication.

threats.title: No Rate Limiting on CheckoutController
threats.description: The CheckoutController process is exposed to external entities without rate limiting.
threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting (e.g. 100 req/min) and circuit breakers.

threats.title: Missing Audit Logging in CheckoutController
threats.description: CheckoutController does not implement structured audit logging for order operations.
threats.mitigation: Add structured audit logs for all state-changing operations with user ID and timestamp.
